remarks: Set just a short distance from the Village of Gowanda, this charming ranch offers comfort, privacy & natural beauty across 8.52 acres surrounded by a variety of trees, including approx 3 acres of loggable timber. The property features a heated 2.5-car detached garage, a spacious Amish-built barn ideal for livestock, equipment, and baled hay storage & a private water well located at the front of the property. On the right side of the property, you'll find a variety of produce & fruit trees, including one peach tree & two apple trees, alongside a vegetable garden providing the opportunity to enjoy your own seasonal harvests. The home features 4 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms, with an inviting open-concept kitchen, living room & dining area, as well as a conveniently located first-floor laundry/pantry room. Luxury vinyl & laminate flooring flow throughout the home, while the fully finished basement, (approximately 600 sq ft)  significantly expands the living space and includes a new egress window and Certificate of Occupancy from the Town of Collins recognizing the two basement rooms as additional bedrooms, offering exceptional flexibility for guests, home offices, or a growing household. A 200-amp electrical service provides ample capacity for future projects and upgrades. Step outside to the screened-in porch on the back deck & enjoy peaceful views of the open green space, perfect for nature walks along the babbling brook or watching wildlife roam freely, while pet owners will appreciate the invisible pet fence already installed on the property. Numerous updates provide peace of mind, including a brand new roof (house and garage) 2026, new gas furnace 2025, new water heater 2025, upgraded water filtration system 2022, reverse osmosis drinking water system, newer windows, recently installed master bedroom windows & side entry door, a mini-split system (approximately 7 years old), & included stove, washer, and dryer (approx 2 years old), all combining to make this property a truly inviting place to call home. Sq Ft differ from tax records - recent egress window with certificate of occupancy from the Town of Collins adds appox 600 sqf ft in lower level.
